prompt: The client wants to know where its growth is coming from. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Coffee is the largest product line
options.feedback: True, but it doesn't answer the client's question.
That misreads the chart: Merchandise fell from 10 to 9; pastries rose from 40 to 41.

options.text: Catering grew because of new corporate clients
options.feedback: The chart doesn't show this. It may be true, but there is no data here to support it.

options.text: Catering drives most of the growth
options.feedback: Right. Total revenue rose 17 (160 to 177); catering added 15 of it (10 to 25).
